messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-89234 triggered for service=redwood-serving-canary. alert: p99 latency > 800ms on canary fraction (10%)

pagerduty: Incident PD-89234 created and paged to oncall. Link: https://pd.company/PD-89234

eric: acked. oncall here. looking

maya: seeing spike in 503 and tokenization timeouts from canary instances. traces show slow kernel loads. rolling back recommended?

sam: confirming deploy id: deploy:2026-03-15T03:14:12Z rev: r-2026-03-15-canary-7a9f. Canary fraction deployed to edge-region-2 with new kv-cache change

katie: pinging infra, can we isolate canary nodes and divert traffic? customers affected? any user reports?

luis: quick check: errors up ~12% for canary pkgs, host-level GPU mem usage normal, but dmesg shows intermittent nvlink reset on 3 nodes

eric: thanks. immediate plan: 1) remove traffic from canary, 2) rollback canary to previous model build, 3) keep dedicated pool for warm fallback. Sam, can you run rollback now?

sam: on it. running rollback cmd:
```
./deployctl rollback --env=prod --service=redwood-serving --target=stable --from-deploy=deploy:2026-03-15T03:14:12Z
```

sam: rollout started, will route canary->stable within 60s for region edge-region-2. watching health checks

pagerduty: PD-89234 acknowledged by eric. Next escalation at +15m if unresolved

maya: FYI: customer-impact flag set to minimal at the moment; only ~0.5% of total traffic routed to canary but error burst concentrated on a small subset of tokenization paths

luis: logs from canary instance canary-3:
```
2026-03-15T03:16:02Z WARN kvcache: invalidation lag=18ms
2026-03-15T03:16:05Z ERROR tokenizer: segmentation fault in quant-kernel
```

katie: moving to handoff mode. I need a short summary for PD handover to next oncall in 10m

eric: summary: deploy r-2026-03-15-canary-7a9f caused p99 latency and 503s on 10% canary. Root suspect: quantization kernel + kv-cache invalidation race. Mitigation: rollback to r-2026-03-08-stable, diverted canary traffic, monitoring. Customer impact: small subset of requests experienced errors; no major outages.

katie: noted. adding to incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/incidents/PD-89234

sam: rollback completed at 03:17:05Z. health checks green. canary nodes drained

maya: verifying metrics... p99 latency back to baseline in edge-region-2. no new 5xx after rollback

pagerduty: PD-89234 status changed to resolved by eric (auto-resolve at 03:20:00Z)

luis: leaving a note: need to add a kernel guard in next patch, and put kvcache invalidation metrics into alerting threshold. Filing ticket #INFR-472

eric: thanks team. Passing to katie for post-incident wrap and severity calc. Will schedule a quick postmortem 1hr from now in #postmortems

katie: taking handoff for follow-up. will coordinate with release and ml infra to block similar quant path for canaries until fix. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-89234 closed. If you were paged, please complete oncall handoff survey: https://oncall.company/survey
